name: Nakadashi Haramase Oyako Donburi
original_name: 中出し孕ませ母娘どんぶり
source: Hiroki has lived alone with his sister Ruka for many years. One day there's a knock on the door and a tiny little girl stands in the doorway. Ruka instantly recognizes the small lady as her mother Mikan who has lived in [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yemen]Yemen[/url] since Hiroki was born. She has returned home and wishes to live as family again but can Hiroki overcome the feeling of abandonment he had as a child? Can they simply start living as a family again after so many lost years? Or will something build in them that goes against the feeling of 'family'?
